user_saw: On a memory-constrained host (768 MiB service cap) the Gateway ran out of memory during startup before its first agent reply.
summary: Deferred many optional runtimes (agent, CLI, cron readers, exec reviewer, skill status, secret providers, OpenAI SDK) to first use, skipped optional warmups under memory pressure, and compacted emitted runtime JavaScript to lower startup memory.
reasoning: PR #197801 is an incremental startup-memory reduction toward a new constrained-device target (issue #192547), and states the 768 MiB service still OOMs; no specific commit is identified as having made startup heavier. This is a broad performance improvement rather than a fix of a behavior that previously worked, so not-a-defect.
